nodes.description: Root-level project configuration including TypeScript, ESLint, PostCSS, Next.js, Playwright, electron-builder, MCP, and component settings
Documentation site configuration including Next.js config, package.json, tsconfig, Tailwind, PostCSS, and shadcn/ui settings
Documentation site content including MDX pages and navigation metadata for both English and Chinese documentation
Electron desktop shell including main process, preload scripts, auto-updater, terminal manager, and window lifecycle management
Syntax highlighting and editor theme definitions including default, GitHub, Nord, Tokyo Night, Kanagawa, and other color schemes

Core backend services including agent loop, AI provider abstraction, Claude client, session parsing, context management, database layer (SQLite), file operations, store, utilities, assistant workspace, buddy system, heartbeat, and error handling
Internationalization resources including locale files and language configuration for multi-language support
TypeScript type definitions and shared interfaces for the application domain model
Unit tests, integration tests, and end-to-end Playwright test suites covering chat, settings, and core functionality
HTTP API route handlers for chat, media, git, settings, skills, plugins, providers, dashboard, doctor, CLI tools, bridge, SDK, and Claude integration endpoints
Message bridge system for cross-platform communication adapters (Telegram, Discord, Feishu, QQ, WeChat), markdown rendering, permission brokering, security validation, and conversation engine
Built-in tool integrations including CLI tools, dashboard widgets, media generation, memory search, notification, session search, and widget guidelines
Feishu channel plugin implementation including gateway, card controller, inbound/outbound message handling, identity management, and resource downloading
Claude Code compatibility layer including SSE parsing, request building, protocol translation, and type definitions for Claude Code protocol emulation
CLI tools catalog, detection, context analysis, and MCP bridge for registering external command-line tools
Application constants including command definitions, icon mappings, and system prompts for image generation agents
Context management including context assembler, compressor, estimator, and pruner for optimizing LLM context window usage
Dashboard subsystem including CLI reader, file reader, MCP integration, store, and data export for persistent widget state
Git integration service providing branch listing, checkout, commit, push, status, and worktree management
CI/CD pipeline configuration including the end-to-end test workflow definition
Static public assets including SVG icon files served by the web frontend
Project documentation including READMEs (English, Chinese, Japanese), CHANGELOG, CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, ARCHITECTURE.md, and developer guides
Documentation site app routes including the home page, not-found handler, and docs page routing via MDX content rendering
Documentation site UI components including home page components, docs components, layout wrappers, providers, and shadcn/ui primitives
Documentation site library utilities for MDX processing, content loading, and navigation logic
Documentation site middleware for internationalization routing and locale detection
Build and packaging scripts including after-pack hook, after-sign codesigning, and Electron bundling
React page components for the chat interface and settings UI within the Next.js app
